court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
case_name: Mohit Mittal And 3 Others v. State Of Up And 2 Others

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Mohit Mittal and 3 others (husband, father-in-law, mother-in-law, sister-in-law)

facts_of_case: Matrimonial dispute between husband and wife. Husband had brain tumor. Wife deserted him. He moved for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act. Present FIR lodged without finalisation of divorce proceeding.

legal_principles.principle: A party's bonafide intention to comply with a compromise can be demonstrated by placing a bank draft in the name of the other party.
legal_principles.held: Just to show his bonafide, the petitioners are ready to place on record a bank draft of Rs.6 lacs on the next date fixed in the matter.
cited_cases: Geeta Mehrotra vs. State of U.P. and others, 2012 (10) ADJ 464
Taramani Parakh vs. State of Madhya Pradesh and others, (2015) 11 SCC 260

legal_principles.principle: A party's non-cooperation in a pending proceeding can be considered as a factor in deciding the matter.
legal_principles.held: Admittedly the proceeding before the Principal Judge, Family Court is pending consideration but inspite of best efforts of the informant, the said proceeding has not been finalised on account of non-cooperation of the first petitioner.

outcome.final_order: Interim protection accorded to petitioners, but writ petition is ultimately dismissed.
